evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “Submission for Office of Management and Budget Review; Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) Financial Report, ACF-196T,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The Administration for Children and Families (ACF) is requesting a 3-year extension of the Guidance for the Tribal Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) Program, Form 123 (Office of Management and Budget (0970-0157, expiration date: August 31, 2026). While the statutory requirements remain unchanged, ACF is proposing revisions to the instructions for clarification and to ensure they are as clear and streamlined as possible. ACF estimates a 33 percent reduction in response time with the proposed revisions to the instructions. A dated source update exists and should be compared with prior records. This record should be preserved, cross-referenced and upgraded only if stronger evidence changes the finding.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
